business_problem: AFCA needed to modernize its aging, customized set of systems to unify data and increase efficiency with automation.
solution_summary: AFCA built its Microsoft solution to improve customer-service and conversational-support workflows. AFCA needed to modernize its aging, customized set of systems to unify data and increase efficiency with automation. Key components included Power BI delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users, and Dynamics 365 Customer Service delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users. Requests and business records enter Dynamics 365 Customer Service, where Dynamics 365 Customer Service assists routing, summaries, or responses before the updated information is surfaced back to employees and customers through the Microsoft application layer. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft. Today, invoice creation is 80% faster, daily administrative tasks are reduced by 40%, and the number of emails that require a manual response has dropped by 27%.

solution_components.name: Azure

To improve the customer and employee experience and strengthen the company's security stance while reducing IT costs, AFCA turned to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance, Supply Chain Management, and Customer Service.

While CASEY and Attache generally functioned well, both systems had become so outdated and customized, that they could no longer be updated and required hosting on external servers to keep them operational.
